svg.title: Passenger Resource Management DTO, entity, and database mapping
svg.desc: UML and data model showing how CreatePassengerDto, ChangeTierDto, CreateResourceDto, and AttemptAccessDto flow through TypeORM entities into PostgreSQL passengers, resources, and immutable usage_records tables.
svg.text: Passenger Resource Management — DTO, Entity & Database Mapping
NestJS validation → application policy → TypeORM persistence → PostgreSQL schema
dashed = maps/uses · solid = persists · crow’s foot = FK cardinality
Quoted camelCase names are PostgreSQL column identifiers.
The expression index prevents case-only duplicate names.
1. Load Passenger and SpaceshipResource by DTO IDs.
4. Snapshot the current names and tiers.
Scalar FK properties only; no TypeORM relation decorators.
Green fields preserve historical context after profile/tier changes.
TR_usage_records_immutable runs BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE and calls prevent_usage_record_mutation().
Every mutation raises "usage records are immutable"; INSERT remains allowed.
